title: Alternating quantum and classical computational modes beget consciousness

statements.text: From autopoiesis, self-reproduction, the no-cloning theorem and organizational invariance follows a principle of alternating computational modes: a unit shares the conscious experience of the decohered quantum system that produced it only if it alternates quantum and classical modes at least once.

sources.quote: we derive the "Principle of Alternating Computational Modes" which begets consciousness
